final: WITH account_flows AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS number_of_transactions FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, number_of_transactions, 1.0 * net_flow / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS share_of_net_flow FROM account_flows ORDER BY share_of_net_flow DESC LIMIT 10
